dimensions.rationale: All named license tiers appearing in any state's text were included in the union, including those mentioned in exclusion or prohibition contexts; synonymous phrasings (e.g., 'apprentice' vs. 'electrical apprentice') were merged into one entry, while genuinely distinct classifications (e.g., residential wireman vs. residential journeyman, air conditioning electrician vs. industrial maintenance electrician) were kept separate.

dimensions.rationale: The union was drawn by collecting every explicitly named exclusion or exemption category across all provided state sentences; synonymous exclusions (e.g., utility generation/distribution work across AK/AL/CA) were merged into single canonical items, while genuinely distinct categories (e.g., elevator controls vs. low-voltage alarms vs. water well wiring) were kept separate, and no items were invented beyond what the source sentences support.

All distinct electrician license tiers named across AK, AL, AR, and AZ sentences are included as separate entries (master, journeyman, residential master, residential journeyman, industrial maintenance, air conditioning, specialist sign, apprentice, electrical administrator, and qualifying party); synonymous phrasings such as 'licensed master electrician' and 'temporary master electrician' are merged as aliases under the core tier, while genuinely distinct scopes (residential vs. general, sign vs. air conditioning) are kept separate.
